data.narrative:
Aslan is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $20.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the same sector, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, alongside public benchmarks (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression methodology, using total capital raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implies a valuation of $51M. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated valuation range of $43M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $225M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around market positioning relative to the peer set. Stage-Progression anchors conservatively at near-term fundraising capacity, while Peer-Median captures the heterogeneity within early-stage Defense & Security valuations. Key uncertainties include Aslan's specific technical differentiation versus UFORCE and Anduril, traction metrics relative to Series A-stage comps, and Defense sector appetite at present funding cycles.
